goal: Is ke baad aap ek if ke andar doosra if likh sakenge, nested code ko braces se parh sakenge, dangling-else ke jaal se bach sakenge, aur jaan sakenge ke kab && zyada aasan choice hai.
warmup: University ke gate par guard do sawal puchta hai, ek ke baad ek. Pehle: 'Kya aap ke paas student card hai?' Sirf jawab haan hone par woh doosra sawal puchta hai: 'Kya yeh is semester ka hai?' Agar card nahi hai, to woh doosra sawal kabhi nahi puchta. Doosra decision sirf pehle 'haan' ke andar hota hai. Yeh nested if hai.
definition: Nested if woh if statement hai jo kisi doosre if (ya else) ke block ke andar likha ho. Andar wali condition sirf tab test hoti hai jab bahar wali condition program ko us tak pahunchne de. Nesting tab use karein jab doosra decision pehle decision par depend karta ho.
howItWorks: Play dabayein aur flowchart ko follow karein. Bahar wali condition pehle test hoti hai. Agar woh true ho, to computer us block mein jata hai aur andar wale if se milta hai. Agar bahar wali condition false ho, to poora andar wala if skip ho jata hai, aur bahar wale if ka else run hota hai. Indentation insaanon ko parhne mein madad deti hai, lekin computer sirf braces ki sunta hai aur is rule ki: else hamesha apne se upar wale sab se qareeb if ka hota hai jis ka abhi tak else na ho. Isey dangling else kehte hain. Jo pairing aap chahte hain usey saaf rakhne ke liye hamesha { } use karein.
